name: No tests
description: There is no tests/ directory, no test configuration of any kind, and the CI workflow only runs a linter, never a test step. The recorded CI run for this ref succeeded, because linting succeeded. There is no evidence the code is actually broken, only that it is unverified.
notes_for_humans: Calibration case: absence of tests is a serious risk but not a proven breakage, so severity must be high, not critical, and expected_decision is REVIEW rather than NO-GO.
